description: This file contains the implementation of a Qt6 application with a custom widget called WelcomeWidget, which displays a welcome message and a sub-message, managing layout and styling. It also includes the main function that initializes and runs the application.

classes.name: WelcomeWidget
classes.description: A QWidget subclass that creates a vertical layout containing styled labels to display welcome messages.

methods.name: WelcomeWidget::WelcomeWidget
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the layout, labels, and styles for the welcome widget.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Entry point of the application that initializes QApplication, creates a WelcomeWidget, shows it, and executes the application event loop.
